name: web_scraping
description: Scrape and analyze a website using curl and Python

steps.description: Fetch the raw HTML of a page
steps.expected_outcome: HTML saved to page.html with line count shown

recovery_hints: Ensure page.html exists (run the fetch step first)
Check the Python script for syntax errors

example_params.command: python -c "import json; links = open('links.txt').readlines(); print(json.dumps([l.strip() for l in links], indent=2))" > results.json

learning_signals: curl -s -L follows redirects and suppresses progress bar
Python html.parser is in the standard library (no pip install needed)
For complex scraping, pip install beautifulsoup4 lxml
Always respect robots.txt and rate-limit requests
